sections.content:
Growing Neural Networks Achieve Flatter Minima
Caillon and Cerisara | ICANN 2021
This fixture summarizes a real paper on optimization and generalization.
The paper studies networks that add neurons incrementally during training and
compares the minima they reach against fixed-size models trained from scratch.
The reported result is that the grown models converge to flatter minima and generalize better.

Caillon and Cerisara | ICANN 2021
